topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can’t help but feel the sun shining a bit brighter today. My buddy and I were catching up, and somehow, the topic of work came up. I mean, who would’ve thought that after all these years, he’d let it slip about the art gallery he’s been managing instead of that mundane office job he kept telling me about? It’s like discovering a hidden gem. I’ve always known there’s more to him than meets the eye. It’s exciting, really, to learn this side of him. Guess it just shows how much more there is to explore in our friendship. Lots to look forward to!
